svg.title: Platform engineering — infrastructure delivery, GitOps and reliability
svg.desc: GitHub Actions and Terraform golden paths provision shared Azure infrastructure using plan gates and just-in-time RBAC. Workload charts and environment configuration in Git are reconciled by Argo CD across DEV, INT and PROD AKS clusters. Controlled promotion and rolling updates are supported by verification gates and drift controls. Prometheus and Grafana provide SLI/SLO health signals. The profile reports three clusters, over 120 nodes collectively, over nine microservices, and 99.9 percent availability.

g.text: Platforms that teams can build on.
3 AKS clusters · 120+ nodes across DEV / INT / PROD · 9+ microservices · 99.9% platform uptime
02 GITOPS DELIVERY / CHARTS + VALUES → DESIRED STATE
